caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular scene bordered by multiple colored frames, including scalloped and striped designs in shades of orange, red, blue, and brown. Inside, the central composition features two canoes, each occupied by people; the canoe on the left contains two figures, while the canoe on the right contains three figures. All the figures are dressed in blue clothing and black hats. The canoes are depicted on stylized blue and white waves. Surrounding the canoes are large, swirling floral and leaf motifs in shades of pink, red, white, green, blue, and brown. Two prominent blue birds are integrated among the floral patterns, one on each side of the central area. At the top center, there is a round brown object resembling a lock plate with a visible keyhole, bordered by a radial scalloped design. The overall color palette includes earth tones and vibrant accents, and the drawing is framed by an overall rectangular border with repeated patterns.
title: Painted Chest
